7	class TeamPlanner(JsonStore):
8	    def add_member(self, member_id, name):
9	        member_id, name = text(member_id, "member_id"), text(name, "name")
10	        data = self._read()
11	        members = data.setdefault("members", {})
12	        if member_id in members:
13	            raise ValueError("member already exists")
14	        members[member_id] = {"member_id": member_id, "name": name}
15	        self._write(data)
16	        return members[member_id]
17	
18	    def create_activity(self, activity_id, title, on, capacity):
19	        activity_id, title = text(activity_id, "activity_id"), text(title, "title")
20	        on, capacity = date.fromisoformat(on).isoformat(), positive(capacity, "capacity")
21	        data = self._read()
22	        activities = data.setdefault("activities", {})
23	        if activity_id in activities:
24	            raise ValueError("activity already exists")
25	        activity = {"activity_id": activity_id, "title": title, "on": on, "capacity": capacity, "participants": []}
26	        activities[activity_id] = activity
27	        self._write(data)
28	        return activity
29	
30	    def enroll(self, activity_id, member_id):
31	        data = self._read()
32	        activity = data.get("activities", {}).get(activity_id)
33	        if activity is None or member_id not in data.get("members", {}):
34	            raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
35	        if member_id in activity["participants"]:
36	            raise ValueError("member already enrolled")
37	        if len(activity["participants"]) >= activity["capacity"]:
38	            raise ValueError("activity is full")
39	        activity["participants"].append(member_id)
40	        self._write(data)
41	        return activity
42	
43	    def enroll_batch(self, records):
44	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every entry is normalized and
45	        # checked before any participant list is touched.
46	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
47	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
48	        entries = []
49	        seen = set()
50	        for item in records:
51	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id"}:
52	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id and member_id")
53	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
54	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
55	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the whole group; one
56	            # member may still join several activities and one activity may
57	            # still receive several members.
58	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
59	            if pair in seen:
60	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
61	            seen.add(pair)
62	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id))
63	        data = self._read()
64	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
65	        members = data.get("members", {})
66	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
67	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
68	            if activity is None or member_id not in members:
69	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
70	            if member_id in activity["participants"]:
71	                raise ValueError("member already enrolled")
72	        # Capacity is judged on the final rosters: the original list plus
73	        # every new enrollment of this group. Completed enrollments keep
74	        # their seats, so the participants lists already cover them.
75	        delta = {}
76	        for activity_id, _ in entries:
77	            delta[activity_id] = delta.get(activity_id, 0) + 1
78	        for activity_id, change in delta.items():
79	            activity = activities[activity_id]
80	            if len(activity["participants"]) + change > activity["capacity"]:
81	                raise ValueError("activity is full")
82	        # Same-day conflicts are judged on the final enrollments too: a new
83	        # enrollment must not collide with the member's existing enrollments
84	        # on that date (completed ones still count) nor with another entry of
85	        # this group. Other members' enrollments and historical conflicts on
86	        # dates the member is not newly joining never block the group.
87	        joining = {}
88	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
89	            joining.setdefault(member_id, {}).setdefault(activities[activity_id]["on"], set()).add(activity_id)
90	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
91	            on = activities[activity_id]["on"]
92	            if len(joining[member_id][on]) > 1:
93	                raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
94	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
95	                if other_id != activity_id and other.get("on") == on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
96	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
97	        # New members are appended to each roster in input order; everyone
98	        # already enrolled keeps their relative position.
99	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
100	            activities[activity_id]["participants"].append(member_id)
101	        self._write(data)
102	        # One full activity object per entry, in input order; an activity
103	        # named by several entries reflects the final roster after the group.
104	        return [activities[activity_id] for activity_id, _ in entries]
105	
106	    def transfer_enrollment(self, source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id):
107	        source_activity_id = text(source_activity_id, "source_activity_id")
108	        target_activity_id = text(target_activity_id, "target_activity_id")
109	        member_id = text(member_id, "member_id")
110	        data = self._read()
111	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
112	        source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
113	        target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
114	        if source is None or target is None or member_id not in data.get("members", {}):
115	            raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
116	        if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
117	            raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
118	        if member_id not in source["participants"]:
119	            raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
120	        if member_id in target["participants"]:
121	            raise ValueError("member is already enrolled in the target activity")
122	        if len(target["participants"]) >= target["capacity"]:
123	            raise ValueError("target activity is full")
124	        # A finished training can neither be moved nor have its completion
125	        # record left behind; other members' records do not block the transfer.
126	        if member_id in data.get("completions", {}).get(source_activity_id, {}):
127	            raise ValueError("member has a completion record for the source activity")
128	        # The member must not keep a seat in a third activity on the target
129	        # date. Completion does not cancel enrollment, so participants lists
130	        # already cover finished trainings; source and target are excluded.
131	        for other_id, other in activities.items():
132	            if other_id in (source_activity_id, target_activity_id):
133	                continue
134	            if other.get("on") == target["on"] and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
135	                raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on the target date")
136	        source["participants"].remove(member_id)
137	        target["participants"].append(member_id)
138	        self._write(data)
139	        return target
140	
141	    def transfer_enrollments(self, changes):
142	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every change is normalized and
143	        # checked before any participant list is touched.
144	        if not isinstance(changes, list) or not changes:
145	            raise ValueError("changes must be a nonempty array")
146	        entries = []
147	        seen = set()
148	        for item in changes:
149	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"source_activity_id", "target_activity_id", "member_id"}:
150	                raise ValueError("each change must contain only source_activity_id, target_activity_id and member_id")
151	            source_activity_id = text(item["source_activity_id"], "source_activity_id")
152	            target_activity_id = text(item["target_activity_id"], "target_activity_id")
153	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
154	            # One member may move only once per group, so no entry can undo or
155	            # chain another entry's move.
156	            if member_id in seen:
157	                raise ValueError("changes must not contain duplicate member ids")
158	            seen.add(member_id)
159	            entries.append((source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id))
160	        data = self._read()
161	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
162	        members = data.get("members", {})
163	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
164	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
165	            source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
166	            target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
167	            if source is None or target is None or member_id not in members:
168	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
169	            if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
170	                raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
171	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
172	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
173	            if member_id in target["participants"]:
174	                raise ValueError("member is already enrolled in the target activity")
175	            # Only the member's own completion record for the source activity
176	            # blocks the move; other members' records never do, and no record
177	            # is ever deleted or migrated.
178	            if member_id in completions.get(source_activity_id, {}):
179	                raise ValueError("member has a completion record for the source activity")
180	        # Capacity is judged on the final rosters after the whole group moves,
181	        # so a swap or rotation between full activities is not rejected by an
182	        # intermediate state.
183	        delta = {}
184	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, _ in entries:
185	            delta[source_activity_id] = delta.get(source_activity_id, 0) - 1
186	            delta[target_activity_id] = delta.get(target_activity_id, 0) + 1
187	        for activity_id, change in delta.items():
188	            activity = activities[activity_id]
189	            if len(activity["participants"]) + change > activity["capacity"]:
190	                raise ValueError("target activity is full")
191	        # Same-day conflicts are judged on the final enrollments too: each
192	        # member appears once, so they only leave their source and join their
193	        # target; a seat in a third activity on the target date rejects the
194	        # whole group. Completed enrollments still count; unrelated historical
195	        # conflicts do not.
196	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
197	            target_on = activities[target_activity_id]["on"]
198	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
199	                if other_id in (source_activity_id, target_activity_id):
200	                    continue
201	                if other.get("on") == target_on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
202	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on the target date")
203	        # Members who stay keep their relative order; moved members are
204	        # appended to their target in input order.
205	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
206	            activities[source_activity_id]["participants"].remove(member_id)
207	            activities[target_activity_id]["participants"].append(member_id)
208	        self._write(data)
209	        # One full target object per entry, in input order; a target named by
210	        # several entries reflects the final roster after the whole group.
211	        return [activities[target_activity_id] for _, target_activity_id, _ in entries]
212	
213	    def preview_transfer_enrollments(self, changes):
214	        # Read-only preview of transfer_enrollments: the same normalization and
215	        # validation, but nothing is ever written back and no missing directory
216	        # or file is created.
217	        if not isinstance(changes, list) or not changes:
218	            raise ValueError("changes must be a nonempty array")
219	        entries = []
220	        seen = set()
221	        for item in changes:
222	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"source_activity_id", "target_activity_id", "member_id"}:
223	                raise ValueError("each change must contain only source_activity_id, target_activity_id and member_id")
224	            source_activity_id = text(item["source_activity_id"], "source_activity_id")
225	            target_activity_id = text(item["target_activity_id"], "target_activity_id")
226	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
227	            # One member may move only once per group, so no entry can undo or
228	            # chain another entry's move.
229	            if member_id in seen:
230	                raise ValueError("changes must not contain duplicate member ids")
231	            seen.add(member_id)
232	            entries.append((source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id))
233	        data = self._read()
234	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
235	        members = data.get("members", {})
236	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
237	        # Structural errors reject the preview outright, exactly as in the
238	        # mutating batch: unknown activity or member, identical activities, a
239	        # missing source enrollment or an existing target enrollment.
240	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
241	            source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
242	            target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
243	            if source is None or target is None or member_id not in members:
244	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
245	            if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
246	                raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
247	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
248	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
249	            if member_id in target["participants"]:
250	                raise ValueError("member is already enrolled in the target activity")
251	        # Remaining seats are judged on the final rosters after the whole group
252	        # moves, so a swap or rotation between full activities leaves every
253	        # named target with a nonnegative count. Entries carrying a completion
254	        # record still count toward the group headcount.
255	        delta = {}
256	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, _ in entries:
257	            delta[source_activity_id] = delta.get(source_activity_id, 0) - 1
258	            delta[target_activity_id] = delta.get(target_activity_id, 0) + 1
259	        remaining = {
260	            activity_id: activities[activity_id]["capacity"] - (len(activities[activity_id].get("participants", [])) + change)
261	            for activity_id, change in delta.items()
262	        }
263	        preview = []
264	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
265	            # Only the member's own completion record for the source activity is
266	            # reported; other members' records never are. A missing completions
267	            # collection means no records at all.
268	            has_completion = member_id in completions.get(source_activity_id, {})
269	            # Conflicts use the final enrollments too: the member only leaves
270	            # the source and joins the target, both of which are excluded, so a
271	            # seat kept in a third activity on the target date is an obstacle.
272	            # Completed enrollments still count; other members' enrollments and
273	            # unrelated historical conflicts never do.
274	            target_on = activities[target_activity_id]["on"]
275	            excluded = {source_activity_id, target_activity_id}
276	            conflict_activity_ids = sorted(
277	                other_id
278	                for other_id, other in activities.items()
279	                if other_id not in excluded
280	                and other.get("on") == target_on
281	                and member_id in other.get("participants", [])
282	            )
283	            preview.append({
284	                "source_activity_id": source_activity_id,
285	                "target_activity_id": target_activity_id,
286	                "member_id": member_id,
287	                "has_completion": has_completion,
288	                "remaining_seats": remaining[target_activity_id],
289	                "conflict_activity_ids": conflict_activity_ids,
290	            })
291	        # All three kinds of obstacles are reported together; only a group where
292	        # every entry is free of a completion record, free of same-day conflicts
293	        # and leaves a nonnegative seat count can be transferred.
294	        can_transfer = all(
295	            not item["has_completion"] and not item["conflict_activity_ids"] and item["remaining_seats"] >= 0
296	            for item in preview
297	        )
298	        return {"can_transfer": can_transfer, "changes": preview}

300	    def split_activity(self, source_activity_id, activity_id, title, on, capacity, member_ids):
301	        # The new session and the enrollment move take effect together: every
302	        # value is normalized and checked before the source roster is touched
303	        # or the new activity is created.
304	        source_activity_id = text(source_activity_id, "source_activity_id")
305	        activity_id, title = text(activity_id, "activity_id"), text(title, "title")
306	        on, capacity = day(on, "on"), positive(capacity, "capacity")
307	        if not isinstance(member_ids, list) or not member_ids:
308	            raise ValueError("member_ids must be a nonempty array")
309	        selected = []
310	        seen = set()
311	        for member_id in member_ids:
312	            member_id = text(member_id, "member_id")
313	            if member_id in seen:
314	                raise ValueError("member_ids must not contain duplicates")
315	            seen.add(member_id)
316	            selected.append(member_id)
317	        # The new session must seat everyone moved into it.
318	        if capacity < len(selected):
319	            raise ValueError("capacity must be at least the number of moved members")
320	        data = self._read()
321	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
322	        members = data.get("members", {})
323	        source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
324	        if source is None:
325	            raise ValueError("unknown activity")
326	        if activity_id in activities:
327	            raise ValueError("activity already exists")
328	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
329	        for member_id in selected:
330	            if member_id not in members:
331	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
332	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
333	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
334	            # Only the member's own completion record for the source activity
335	            # blocks the move; other members' records never do, and no record
336	            # is ever deleted or migrated.
337	            if member_id in completions.get(source_activity_id, {}):
338	                raise ValueError("member has a completion record for the source activity")
339	        # A moved member must not keep a seat in a third activity on the new
340	        # date. Completion does not cancel enrollment, so participants lists
341	        # already cover finished trainings; the source is excluded and other
342	        # members' enrollments or other dates never block the split.
343	        for member_id in selected:
344	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
345	                if other_id == source_activity_id:
346	                    continue
347	                if other.get("on") == on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
348	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
349	        # Members who stay keep their relative order; the new roster follows
350	        # the input order exactly. The source keeps all its other fields and
351	        # stays in the file even when its roster becomes empty.
352	        moving = set(selected)
353	        source["participants"] = [member_id for member_id in source["participants"] if member_id not in moving]
354	        activity = {"activity_id": activity_id, "title": title, "on": on, "capacity": capacity, "participants": list(selected)}
355	        activities[activity_id] = activity
356	        self._write(data)
357	        return {"source_activity": source, "new_activity": activity}

422	    def reschedule_activities(self, changes):
423	        if not isinstance(changes, list) or not changes:
424	            raise ValueError("changes must be a nonempty array")
425	        entries = []
426	        seen = set()
427	        for item in changes:
428	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "on"}:
429	                raise ValueError("each change must contain only activity_id and on")
430	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
431	            on = day(item["on"], "on")
432	            if activity_id in seen:
433	                raise ValueError("changes must not contain duplicate activity ids")
434	            seen.add(activity_id)
435	            entries.append((activity_id, on))
436	        data = self._read()
437	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
438	        selected = []
439	        for activity_id, on in entries:
440	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
441	            if activity is None:
442	                raise ValueError("unknown activity")
443	            selected.append(activity)
444	        # Only activities whose date actually moves are constrained; entries
445	        # keeping their date may carry completion records or old conflicts.
446	        moving = [(activity, on) for activity, (_, on) in zip(selected, entries) if on != activity["on"]]
447	        # Nothing to change: return the activities as they are and leave the
448	        # file untouched, even when completion records or conflicts exist.
449	        if not moving:
450	            return selected
451	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
452	        final_on = {activity_id: on for activity_id, on in entries}
453	        # Conflicts are judged against every activity's date AFTER the whole
454	        # group moves, so feasible swaps are not rejected by an intermediate
455	        # state. Validate everything before touching any date.
456	        for activity, on in moving:
457	            activity_id = activity["activity_id"]
458	            if completions.get(activity_id):
459	                raise ValueError("activity already has completion records")
460	            participants = set(activity.get("participants", []))
461	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
462	                if other_id == activity_id:
463	                    continue
464	                other_on = final_on.get(other_id, other.get("on"))
465	                if other_on != on:
466	                    continue
467	                # Completion keeps the enrollment, so participants lists already
468	                # include members who finished the training; an activity in
469	                # which only other members are enrolled is no conflict.
470	                if participants & set(other.get("participants", [])):
471	                    raise ValueError("participant is enrolled in another activity on that date")
472	        for activity, on in moving:
473	            activity["on"] = on
474	        self._write(data)
475	        return selected

484	        seen = set()
485	        for item in changes:

491	                raise ValueError("changes must not contain duplicate activity ids")
492	            seen.add(activity_id)
493	            entries.append((activity_id, on))

495	        activities = data.get("activities", {})

527	                    for member_id in participants & set(other.get("participants", [])):
528	                        blocked.setdefault(member_id, []).append(other_id)
529	                conflicts = [{"member_id": member_id, "activity_ids": sorted(ids)} for member_id, ids in sorted(blocked.items())]

572	    def record_completions(self, records):
573	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every entry is normalized and
574	        # checked before any record is written.
575	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
576	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
577	        entries = []
578	        seen = set()
579	        for item in records:
580	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id", "completed_on"}:
581	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id, member_id and completed_on")
582	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
583	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
584	            completed_on = day(item["completed_on"], "completed_on")
585	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the whole group even when
586	            # both entries carry the same completion date; records are never
587	            # merged. Cross-activity and cross-member entries are allowed.
588	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
589	            if pair in seen:
590	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
591	            seen.add(pair)
592	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id, completed_on))
593	        data = self._read()
594	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
595	        members = data.get("members", {})
596	        done = data.setdefault("completions", {})
597	        # Validate every entry first: the activity and member must exist, the
598	        # member must be enrolled, the completion date must not precede the
599	        # activity date, and neither the stored history nor an earlier entry in
600	        # this group may already hold the member's own record. Other members'
601	        # records never block the entry.
602	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
603	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
604	            if activity is None:
605	                raise ValueError("unknown activity")
606	            if member_id not in members:
607	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
608	            if member_id not in activity.get("participants", []):
609	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the activity")
610	            if member_id in done.get(activity_id, {}):
611	                raise ValueError("completion already recorded")
612	            if date.fromisoformat(completed_on) < date.fromisoformat(activity["on"]):
613	                raise ValueError("completed_on must be on or after the activity date")
614	        # Only the selected records are added, in input order; enrollments keep
615	        # occupying capacity and participant order, profiles and activity fields
616	        # (including extra fields) are left untouched.
617	        result = []
618	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
619	            done.setdefault(activity_id, {})[member_id] = completed_on
620	            activity = activities[activity_id]
621	            result.append({"activity_id": activity_id, "member_id": member_id, "completed_on": completed_on, "title": activity["title"], "on": activity["on"]})
622	        self._write(data)

625	    def correct_completions(self, records):
626	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every entry is normalized and
627	        # checked before any stored record is changed.
628	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
629	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
630	        entries = []
631	        seen = set()
632	        for item in records:
633	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id", "completed_on"}:
634	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id, member_id and completed_on")
635	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
636	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
637	            # null revokes the record; any other value must be a strict, real
638	            # YYYY-MM-DD date exactly like a fresh completion entry.
639	            completed_on = None if item["completed_on"] is None else day(item["completed_on"], "completed_on")
640	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the whole group even when
641	            # both entries set the same date; same-date entries are not merged.
642	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
643	            if pair in seen:
644	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
645	            seen.add(pair)
646	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id, completed_on))
647	        data = self._read()
648	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
649	        members = data.get("members", {})
650	        done = data.get("completions", {})
651	        # Validate every entry first: the activity and member must exist, the
652	        # member must stay enrolled, and the member's own record must already
653	        # exist so it can be corrected. A new date must not precede the
654	        # activity date; revocation (null) carries no date check.
655	        previous = []
656	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
657	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
658	            if activity is None:
659	                raise ValueError("unknown activity")
660	            if member_id not in members:
661	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
662	            if member_id not in activity.get("participants", []):
663	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the activity")
664	            record = done.get(activity_id, {}).get(member_id)
665	            if record is None:
666	                raise ValueError("no completion record to correct")
667	            previous.append(record)
668	            if completed_on is not None and date.fromisoformat(completed_on) < date.fromisoformat(activity["on"]):
669	                raise ValueError("completed_on must be on or after the activity date")
670	        # Only the selected records change: a new date replaces the old one and
671	        # null deletes just that member's record. Enrollments keep occupying
672	        # capacity and participant order; profiles, activity fields (including
673	        # extra fields) and other members' records are left untouched.
674	        changed = False
675	        result = []
676	        for (activity_id, member_id, completed_on), old in zip(entries, previous):
677	            activity = activities[activity_id]
678	            records_for_activity = done[activity_id]
679	            if completed_on is None:
680	                del records_for_activity[member_id]
681	            else:
682	                records_for_activity[member_id] = completed_on
683	            if completed_on != old:
684	                changed = True
685	            result.append({"activity_id": activity_id, "member_id": member_id, "title": activity["title"], "on": activity["on"], "previous_completed_on": old, "completed_on": completed_on})
686	        # A group where every date already equals the stored one succeeds but
687	        # leaves the file untouched, like a same-date reschedule.
688	        if changed:
689	            self._write(data)
690	        return result

707	    def merge_member(self, source_member_id, target_member_id):
708	        source = text(source_member_id, "source_member_id")
709	        target = text(target_member_id, "target_member_id")
710	        if source == target:
